## Schedule Overview

Round 2 counselling runs from **April 22 to April 28**, 2026. Candidates who were allotted seats in Round 1 but did not report must participate in Round 2 to retain eligibility.

- Day 1: B.Tech
- Day 2: MBA
- Day 3: Law

Candidates should carry their original documents including admit card, mark sheets, and identity proof for verification at the reporting centre. Reporting timings are from 9 AM to 4 PM on each day. No extensions will be granted after the scheduled dates.
